Category: Races / Culture

Overview

A hereditary trait found in the Greenholt family that occasionally expresses in family members.
It functions like a "recessive gene" in modern terms.

Details

Those who express the trait have elven features and live extraordinarily long lives.
Those who don't look like normal humans and live normal human lifespans.
The family members are not elves and don't consider themselves elves, though the ancestry question remains open.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} has the strongest expression of this trait — he has lived longer than anyone else in his family line.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} also carries the trait, sharing the same elven features and origin in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}.
Castor is in fact Garland's great-grand-uncle — the elder of the line, despite Garland being the more mature in bearing.

Related Entries

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} — Strongest known expression of the trait
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} — Also carries the trait
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} — Where both Garland and Castor originate

Sources

  • Session 0 — Established during character creation

Notes

The origin of this trait — whether it connects to actual elven ancestry or something else — remains an open question.
